start.title: Guided tour
start.body: Seven chapters that walk a client through the whole story on the real screens. The tour drives the demo workspace: it sends the lead, opens the thread, and points at what matters.
start.presentHint: Chapters move on by themselves. For a demo you are giving.
start.selfServeHint: Next moves a chapter on; the steps that ask for something show you where to click. For a client on their own.
start.checklistHint: Pick any chapter to jump straight to it.

card.waiting: Do it on the screen when you are ready.
card.gap: This screen isn't ready yet. Carry on with Next.
card.doneBody: One student enquiry: Instagram ad to WhatsApp to quotation to money in the owner's dashboard. Start again whenever you like.

toast.title: A new enquiry just arrived
toast.failed: The demo could not set this step up. Carry on with Next.

arrives.body: An Instagram intake ad just delivered a real student enquiry into the demo workspace. Nothing was typed in by hand.

listed.title: Straight to the top
listed.body: Every enquiry lands in one list, newest first, with the campaign that produced it.

speed.title: Speed is the product
speed.body: The saffron chip counts down the reply window. Fifteen minutes is SBC's own rule, and it is visible to whoever picks it up.

owner.body: Round-robin gave the lead to a student counsellor the second it arrived. Nobody has to triage it in the morning.

task.title: And it has a task
task.body: A follow-up was created with it: call within fifteen minutes. It sits on the lead and on the counsellor's day.

thread.body: The student writes to SBC on WhatsApp. It lands in the same record as the ad, so the whole conversation sits in one place.

window.title: The 24-hour rule
window.body: WhatsApp allows free replies for 24 hours after the student's last message. The bar shows exactly how long is left.

composer.title: Reply from here
composer.body: Type and send. It goes out on SBC's WhatsApp number and lands on the lead's timeline as a message.

convert.body: Press Convert to deal. The name, the number and the service all came across from the ad. Nothing was retyped.

dialog.title: Nothing to retype
dialog.body: Contact, service and stage are already set. Type SBC's fee, then Convert to deal writes the contact, the deal and the history in one go.

board.title: On the board
board.body: The deal is in New enquiry with its fee, its counsellor and its source. That is a real application in the pipeline now, not a row in a register.

drag.body: Drag the card into Counselling done. On a phone, use Move to. The board writes the change down as it happens.

won.title: And finish it
won.body: Drop it on Visa approved once the visa comes through — on a phone, open Counselling done and use Move to. The deal closes, and the whole history stays with it.

build.body: The service is already priced. Add it from SBC's own fee list, then check what the student will see.

totals.title: 16% sales tax, in PKR
totals.body: Subtotal, sales tax and total are worked out as you go, in rupees and with SBC's NTN. Press Save draft.

pdf.title: A real quotation
pdf.body: This is a proper quotation for the student and their family to keep. Embassy and university fees are kept off it. Download PDF gives you the file that gets sent.

send.title: Send it on WhatsApp
send.body: Press Send on WhatsApp. The PDF goes out inside the 24-hour window and is filed against the deal.

landed.title: It's in the chat
landed.body: The quotation is now a document in the conversation, linked to the quote and the deal. One record, from ad to answer.

money.body: What is open, what is weighted, what closed this month. This is the screen the owner actually buys.

sources.title: What brings business
sources.body: TikTok sends the most enquiries and none of them has become a deal. Instagram brings the most applications and visa approvals. SBC can see where to spend its ad budget.
